# Function Basics

#### Course: Learn Recursion with Python

## Function Basics

We know that functions are independent pieces of code that can be reused again and again. In many ways, they're like machines that can take input(s) to produce an output.

In technical terms, Python functions usually consist of the following:

- Arguments - what values the functions might take.
- Return value - what value the function will return.

![Using arguments and return value allows us to make a function an independent piece of code.](data:image/png;base64,)
